notes: Fixes HTTPS on machines where the app could not verify certificates. Affected users saw 'certificate verify failed' in the activity log, but the impact was wider than the news calendar: the same fault silently blocked the automatic update check, Telegram alerts, online licence validation and the AI assistant. The certificate bundle is now shipped with the app and all network calls share one verified connection path. If you have seen that error, this update restores update notifications as well as the news feed. Trading itself was never affected.
